milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the smooth sandstone stairs and face them. Target is the center of the larger temple's stair crown at spawn-relative (9, 4, 12). With max_distance=10 (reduced from 16 per ValidatorAgent feedback), the player must walk at least 5-6 blocks from spawn before this can trigger, ensuring actual navigation occurred. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the stairs, not just standing nearby.

Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone with any pickaxe drops the sandstone block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no sandstone in inventory, so min_count=1 confirms they successfully mined at least one block. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly confirms the player obtained the resource. The wooden pickaxe provided is sufficient (mining level 0 can mine sandstone).
